test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

You must employ additional hands __in complete the project in time.__

options.text: in completing the project in time
for completing the project of time
to complete the project on time

solution:
The correct answer is '**to complete the project on time'*****.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined words can be replaced by the term **to complete the project on time.__**
 
• Here the **in** is replaced by **to** because the sentence is** expressing a goal**. The work must have to be complete and for that reason extra hand is required. So the **goal** is **to complete the project.**

__**Correct answer:**__ *You must employ additional hands __to complete the project on time__.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• To is a preposition and a versatile little word that can be used to say many things.

 
• You can use it **to indicate a goal or a direction of movement, as well as a place of arrival**.
